t: Napleswise | Procida | Our guide to exploring the island of Procida
s: September 21, 2025 - A lot of the main attractions on Procida can be easily reached on foot via a short walk. If you are staying near the main port, you’ll find plenty of restaurants, shops and beaches within just a few minutes. If you are feeling somewhat energetic, you can walk the length of the island in around an hour. Another option to get around is to use the local buses to navigate between the island’s main points of interest. To use the buses you’ll need to buy your tickets in advance from a tabaccheria (some buses allow you to buy onboard in cash, but the price is higher compared to buying in advance), or using MooneyGo, our recommended smartphone app for public transport tickets in Italy.
